description: Get the full text of a surah (chapter) of the Quran by its number (1-114). Returns every ayah (verse) in the chosen edition. Use an English translation edition (e.g. en.asad, en.sahih) for English, or quran-uthmani for the Arabic text.

edition.description: Edition identifier. Default 'en.asad' (English translation). Other examples: 'en.sahih' (English), 'quran-uthmani' (Arabic).

name: get_surah
title: Get Surah
